name: Reza Nakagawa-Diallo
description: Reza Nakagawa-Diallo holds the unusual distinction of having crossed corponation lines in both directions: originally contracted to HelixCorp's entertainment subsidiary, he broke contract in 2218 to work for a Vantablack production, triggering a legal dispute that was settled out of public record. His neural signature — a quality critics describe as 'suspended dread, elegantly maintained' — is considered among the most technically accomplished in the current generation of performers. He is currently under a Vantablack contract with terms that have never been disclosed.
cultural_impact: His contract dispute became a widely cited case study in the impossibility of talent mobility across corponation boundaries, discussed openly in performer advocacy communities.
story_hooks: The sealed settlement documents from the HelixCorp dispute contain terms that, if public, would expose practices both corporations want hidden — someone has a copy.
Nakagawa-Diallo is secretly communicating with an independent director he cannot legally work with; a player is asked to facilitate the meeting without leaving a traceable record.
A HelixCorp operative is building a case to have him imprisoned under the original breach-of-contract terms — the sealed settlement notwithstanding — and the player must decide which side to help.
